sprint_goal: Establish secure cloud foundation and local data layer
key_deliverables: VPC & Networking Stack; ECS Fargate Cluster; Local Isar DB Schema; Auth0 Configuration
demo_objectives: Show AWS infrastructure deployed via CDK; Demonstrate local DB persistence on mobile
success_criteria: Infrastructure deployed to staging; Mobile app builds and persists data locally
risk_factors: AWS CDK learning curve; Cross-platform Isar compatibility
mitigation_strategies: Pair programming on CDK; Early prototype of Isar on devices

sprint_goal: Implement full authentication flow and external data proxy
key_deliverables: Social Login (Google/Apple); Auth Repository; Google Books API Proxy
demo_objectives: User login/logout flow; Searching for a book via the proxy endpoint
success_criteria: Users can log in; Secure token storage verified; Book search returns results without exposing API key
risk_factors: Native auth config issues; Sync protocol complexity
mitigation_strategies: Early testing on physical devices; Detailed spec review for sync

sprint_goal: Deliver robust offline synchronization and AI foundation
key_deliverables: Background Sync Service; Conflict Resolution; Library Sync API; Embedding Job
demo_objectives: Modify data offline, reconnect, and see sync; Background job logs for AI
success_criteria: Data consistency across devices; Sync handles conflicts; Vectors generated
risk_factors: Sync conflict logic errors; iOS background restrictions
mitigation_strategies: Extensive unit testing of conflict resolver; Use simple background fetch first
